details: VELDO-0150 detail: own-message/telegram: his message accepts it; the acceptance is recorded as his own message's, naming the intake command; the observation records the path and the intake command

VELDO-0150 detail: own-message/api: his request accepts it with nothing presented; the acceptance is recorded as his own message's, naming the intake command; the metrics count two acceptances by his own message

VELDO-0150 detail: own-message/non-owner-presented: his message does not accept the Telegram one: refused not_owner:source, nothing written; nor the API one: refused not_owner:source, nothing written; the metrics count the refused own-message acceptances and the answers

VELDO-0150 detail: own-message/admits-nothing: a feature is proposed under the objective his message accepted; the feature is RAW: neither admitted nor prioritized; nothing but the objective names the feature

VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/bound-intake-command: the Telegram acceptance names the intake command that first wrote the message's source; with the message's canonical attribution: message id, sender and platform time; the API acceptance names its request, principal and signed digest; evidence naming another message's intake command is refused by name, nothing written; evidence naming no intake command is refused by name; the message's own intake command accepts it
VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/same-bound-fields: the Telegram acceptance binds outcome, scope, authority and evidence requirements exactly; so does the API acceptance; both paths bind the same fields
VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/project-not-his: his message does not accept it as its owner's: not_owner:source
VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/repeat: its acceptance again returns the same acceptance; with no second record: the objective and the journal unchanged
VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/stale-revision: an acceptance naming revision 1 is refused by name; so is one naming revision 1's bound digest; the acceptance of the current revision binds revision 2

VELDO-0150 detail: authorship/member-authored-presented: her acceptance naming olga's intake command is refused not_authorized:author; so is the PM's delivering the same message; another project's owner writing it in proj-a is refused the same way
VELDO-0150 detail: authorship/owner-authored: her message accepts it with nothing presented
VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/repeat-after-checks: a repeat by a principal outside proj-a's scope is refused not_authorized:scope, not repeated; a member in scope still gets the same acceptance

VELDO-0150 detail: evidence/paused-project: her message's acceptance while paused is refused project_not_active:PAUSED; a repeat of an accepted message while paused is refused the same way, not repeated; once resumed her message accepts it
